login.title: Log in
login.intro: Enter the e-mail address you confirmed for your web access at the teacher's desk. You get a link, there is no password.
login.sent: If this address belongs to a web access, a mail with a link is on its way now.
login.sentHint: The link works for 15 minutes. If no mail arrives, check the address and the spam folder. A new mail is possible after one minute.
login.noAccess: No web access yet? You set it up in the game at the teacher's desk, on the tab “Web access”.
login.invalidEmail: That is not an e-mail address.
login.linkIntro: With the button you log in in this browser.
login.duration: The login lasts 12 hours. On a computer that others use too, log out when you are done.

overview.title: Overview
overview.soon: Progress and protocols will follow here in the next steps.

groups.title: Groups
groups.introAdmin: As school administration you see every group. You rename groups and assign teachers to them.
groups.introTeacher: You see the groups the school administration assigned you to.
groups.emptyTeacher: You are not assigned to a group yet. The school administration does that.
groups.emptyAdmin: There is no group yet. The server admin creates groups together with their world.
groups.name: Name
groups.assignHint: You can choose from all accounts with web access. Assigned teachers see this group in the web application.
groups.noCandidates: There is no teacher with web access yet.
groups.readOnly: Only the school administration can change this.
groups.addressHint: How the children reach the world, for example “spiel.schule.example, port 30000”. The address is printed on the access slips.

students.intro: Account names are rolled and say nothing about the child. Only you know who is behind an account.
students.empty: This group has no accounts yet.
students.draftHint: Rolled names are a draft first. If you do not like one, roll it again. Only “Create accounts” creates them in the world.
students.create: Create no accounts | Create one account | Create {count} accounts
students.refusedHint: Refused names exist in the world already. Roll them again or remove them.
students.pendingHint: The world creates the accounts as soon as it is connected. The list updates by itself.
students.resetConfirm: The old password will no longer work.

password.pending: new password waits for the world
password.refused: new password refused by the world, the old one still counts

students.search: Search for account or display name

displayChange.pending: change is waiting for the world

historyActions.given_up: {day}: back to the account name, before “{name}”

students.historyHint: The history comes from the protocol of the world and is deleted with the end of the school year.

slips.title: Access slips
slips.once: The start passwords are shown here only now. The backend does not keep them. Print the slips before you leave the page.
slips.namesHint: On each slip you can enter the name of the child, but you do not have to. The names stay in this browser, are neither stored nor sent, and only appear on the printout. Empty fields are not printed.
slips.heading: Your access to the learning world
slips.hint: Type name and password exactly like this, capital and small letters too. You can change your password in the game.
slips.confirmLeave: The passwords cannot be shown again afterwards.
slips.resetNote: The new password counts as soon as the world has taken it. Until then the old one does. A child who is in the game right now stays logged in.

progress.intro: The table shows what the world reported last. Click a field to see the tasks of the level. There you also set a level or lock moving up.
progress.pendingHint: A change is waiting for the world. The table updates by itself.
progress.noModules: The world of this group has not reported any learning modules yet.
progress.noStudents: This group has no accounts yet that exist in the world.

change.pending: change is waiting for the world

progress.changeHint: The world makes the change and notes it in the protocol of the teacher's desk. With moving up locked the child stays on their level, even after finishing its workload.
progress.repeatHint: Repeating empties the workload of this level. Every task counts and is rewarded again. The reward for completing the level is given the first time only.

protocols.intro: This is what the world wrote down. The protocols name the account, below it stands the display name of today. They are deleted with the end of the school year.
protocols.exportHint: The file holds the filtered entries. It leaves the platform: you answer for the file, and the end of the school year does not delete it. Every download is written down and visible to the school administration.
protocols.waiting: Show {n} new entry | Show {n} new entries
protocols.empty: There are no entries that match.

yearEnd.title: End of the year
yearEnd.loading: Loading the end of the year …
yearEnd.intro: The end of the year is the one moment data is deleted on a large scale. It is for the whole school, not for single groups.
yearEnd.deleted: All protocols of all groups: chat, signs, rewards, teacher's desk and display names, in the worlds and here. And the list of exports.
yearEnd.kept: Accounts, progress, trophies and display names of the students, the groups and their teachers.
yearEnd.later: There are no archived worlds and backups yet. Once there are, the end of the year deletes them too.
yearEnd.exports: Entries in the list of exports
yearEnd.look: Look at and export the protocols

worldStates.pending: has not deleted its protocols yet

yearEnd.warning: This cannot be undone. Export what you need before, through the protocols of the groups.
yearEnd.close: Close the year and delete the protocols
yearEnd.done: The year is closed. The protocols here are deleted. Every world deletes its own as soon as it reports; the table shows which one is still missing.
yearEnd.run: {day}: by {account}, {entries} entries in protocols and {exports} in the list of exports deleted, {groups} groups

live.offline: The connection to the backend is lost. The page shows the last state and updates again as soon as the connection is back.

health.title: Status
health.intro: This page shows whether the backend can be reached and can do its work.

mail.terminal: not set up, mails are written to the terminal of the backend

confirm.title: Confirm your e-mail address
confirm.intro: You entered an address for your web access at the teacher's desk. With the button you confirm that it is yours.
confirm.doneAccount: It now belongs to the account {account}. The teacher's desk shows the new status in a few seconds.
confirm.missing: The part from the mail is missing in this address. Open the whole link from the mail again.
confirm.again: At the teacher's desk you can ask for a new mail on the tab “Web access”.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: This address does not exist here.

errors.title: That did not work
errors.unauthorized: You are not signed in or not allowed to do this.
errors.name_taken: Another group already has this name.
errors.no_names: No free name turned up. Please try again.
errors.invalid_token: This link no longer works. It is too old or was used already.
errors.address_taken: This address already belongs to another account.
errors.internal: The backend ran into an error.
errors.unexpected: The backend gave an unexpected answer.
